scope: Experimental native AMD64 containers, isolated Home Assistant Container, and a separately qualified dedicated Sonoff HA flashing trial

environment.radio: Owner-confirmed transfer; Linux specialist passively verified Sonoff ZBDongle-E sniffer 0.12 using CRC-valid ESN1 records; current bootloader remains unverified

gates.required_evidence: Reviewed committed source including the required ancestor, passing checks, clean-source build context hash, exact distribution/daemon/firmware-compatibility/integration versions, and source revision bound to the resulting artifact
Actual Docker image ID, linux/amd64 inspection, runtime version checks, build recipe and base-image identities; record a registry digest only if one exists and hash any delivered archive
Fresh startup, health, authenticated API, websocket behavior, persistent configuration/catalog/database, restart and container recreation with no radio access; rerun on the committed artifact
gates.limitation: A nonexistent serial port tests offline behavior; it does not prove simulated or physical radio control

gates.required_evidence: Fresh integration installation against a known isolated simulated daemon, authentication, state updates, disconnect/reconnect, HA and daemon restart, and preserved entry/device/entity identity without duplicate registrations
gates.observed: Default simulated-endpoint rejection and explicit opt-in; authenticated API; three registered entities; two-gang ON/OFF; daemon reconnect and HA restart with stable registry identifiers; SQLite integrity
gates.limitations: One-gang control unavailable because simulator startup reports use the wrong suffix; not a passing control test. Repeat acceptance on the clean committed artifact. Same-version restarts are not upgrades.

gates.required_evidence: Record absence honestly. First-install/recreation is not a version upgrade. If a separately source-bound historical AMD64 build is used later, identify it as a test-built baseline and test preserved data plus rollback without claiming it was previously published.
Actual x86-64 Supervisor app discovery, installation, startup, options/ingress, data persistence, update and restoration with the intended image channel
gates.limitation: HA Container plus a companion daemon does not qualify the Supervisor app channel

gates.required_evidence: Confirm physical transfer, exact board/revision, USB topology/identity, current firmware, ownership and reviewed recovery path before an explicitly scoped hardware trial
gates.constraints: No automatic protocol commands or flash; writes only through the reviewed explicit action. Do not reuse ZB-GW04 policy or firmware.

gates.required_evidence: Exact-board provider and loader/security policy, reviewed private candidate and recovery artifacts, actual HA inspect/explicit install, independent application VERSION/CAPS/STATUS, explicit new-network initialization/handoff, and scoped failure/recovery checks on the clean AMD64 image
gates.constraints: No fabricated gateway baseline for the starting sniffer. Cancellation without a baseline cannot claim restored sniffer or gateway service. Recovery needs its own explicit action and passive sniffer verification. Keep firmware qualified:false until the relevant tests pass.

gates.required_evidence: Supported architecture/channel verified, immutable versioned artifacts and complete release inventory, firmware qualification/redistribution gates satisfied, and reviewed release decision
gates.constraints: Do not change public ARM64 manifests, app architecture listing or immutable tags while AMD64 remains experimental

exploratory_artifact_reported_by_linux_s.source: Required ancestor plus uncommitted packaging changes

packaging_review.scope: Candidate-only AMD64 staging and native CI matrix; no public architecture promotion
packaging_review.platform_guard: Reject unsupported publication platform before Git resolution or output creation; regression test does not depend on the checkout revision
